case.intent: Make an equivalent fraction on a fraction bar

data.title: Building Equivalent Fractions — Grade 4
data.description: Discover different ways to show the exact same amount by splitting and shading your fraction bar. Explore how changing the number of equal parts creates equivalent fractions!

challenges.instruction: Make a fraction equal to 5/10 your own way: split the bar into equal parts, but not 10, then shade some.
Make a fraction equal to 8/12 your own way: split the bar into equal parts, but not 12, then shade some.
Make a fraction equal to 4/12 your own way: split the bar into equal parts, but not 12, then shade some.
Make a fraction equal to 2/5 your own way: split the bar into equal parts, but not 5, then shade some.
